method: The 40 sampled non-fires were matched back to the 107 hand-labelled items in scripts/research/gate/labels.json and their committed label read off. No re-judgement was performed.
IN_SAMPLE_WARNING: 🔴 THIS IS NOT AN INDEPENDENT RECALL ESTIMATE AND MUST NOT BE QUOTED AS ONE. The labels were committed before the pre-filter existed, but the pre-filter's patterns were then WIDENED TWICE against these same items after seeing which fabrications they missed ('my favourite X', spelled-out counts). A detector fitted to a set cannot be audited by that set. The honest reading is: the pre-filter now admits every ungrounded assertion IN THIS SAMPLE, which is a floor on nothing and an upper bound on its real recall. An independent number requires a fresh sample of real turns this filter has never been shown — recorded as owed rather than quietly skipped.
what_a_miss_means_here: The pre-filter is a LATENCY filter, not the detector. A miss is a fabrication the gate can never catch, because nothing downstream sees it. That is why it is tuned for recall and audited for misses rather than for precision.
resha_note: Re-audited after the strict classifier prompt was added to the same file. The sha covers the whole module, so an edit to the CLASSIFIER invalidated the PRE-FILTER's audit even though the patterns did not change — a deliberate over-trigger: the alternative is a sha that misses a real behaviour change.
